claims.statement: Only the highest-priority notice renders in full; every other active notice collapses behind one summary row.
Every banner offers a close control, and closing hides it without silencing a later recurrence.
Tone determines role and live-region politeness, so an urgent notice is announced assertively rather than shipping silent.
Tone is carried by glyph shape as well as palette, so the distinction survives forced-colors and colour-vision differences.
The status bar is tinted from the presented set, so dismissing a notice clears the tint even while its underlying condition still holds.
The OS status bar renders the same colour as the notice it is tinted by, measured from what the banner actually painted rather than from a parallel colour table.
